annotation.evidence_span: or else large window sizes will appear like negative windows and TCP will now work
annotation.interpretation_a: The clause could be read as requiring the window size to be unsigned, otherwise large windows would appear negative and TCP would fail.
annotation.interpretation_b: Alternatively, it could be read as requiring the window size to be unsigned, otherwise large windows would appear negative and TCP would still work.
annotation.justification: The clause lacks a clear constraint on the consequences of not treating the window size as unsigned, allowing two materially different interpretations of the intended behavior.
